arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-21' AND date < '2019-10-28'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the most recent complete Monday-to-Sunday week before the end of the data.
assumptions: 'Last week' is anchored to the last day of the data, 2019-10-31 (a Thursday), so the most recent complete Monday-Sunday week is 2019-10-21 (Monday) through 2019-10-27 (Sunday).
The week of 2019-10-28 to 2019-11-03 is not used, because it runs past the end of the data and is only partly covered.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts.
